answer: Each new agent must hold a 35 POA stake in a cedar-class tier and earns task access only through a 10-day glacier-slow trust ramp: weekly caps rise 5, 10, 20 jobs. Spinning up N fakes costs 35N POA locked for 10 days plus N x 35 jobs of real work, so 1,000 fakes tie up 35,000 POA, while an honest user pays 35 once. Random auditors re-run 7% of results, and each vertex in the referral graph with a failed audit forfeits 70% of its stake, making cost grow linearly in N with loss risk on top.
